scripts.all: pnpm run build && concurrently --group -n format,lint,typecheck,test-fix,v8,e2e,knip 'pnpm run format' 'pnpm run lint:fix' 'pnpm run typecheck' 'pnpm run test-fix' 'pnpm run test:v8:update' 'pnpm run test:e2e:update' 'pnpm run knip'
scripts.check: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test
scripts.format: oxfmt --write package.json knip.json tsconfig.packages.json vitest.v8.config.ts .oxlintrc.json .oxfmtrc.json oxlint-plugin-local.mjs scripts packages e2e-tests v8-tests
scripts.format:check: oxfmt --check package.json knip.json tsconfig.packages.json vitest.v8.config.ts .oxlintrc.json .oxfmtrc.json oxlint-plugin-local.mjs scripts packages e2e-tests v8-tests
